note: Fastest of three runs, milliseconds, per platform. The check fails at a factor of 2, not at a percentage, because that is the difference between a real regression and scheduler noise. Record on the CI runner for the platform, not on a workstation: the two differ by up to a factor of two, which the factor of two then has to absorb. Re-record with `node scripts/perf-check.mjs --write` after a deliberate change, and update the figures in README.md to match.
